name: bacpack
description: ManageBac CLI: check what's due, log CAS experiences, and add Learner Portfolio entries from the terminal.

scripts.compile: bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile ~/.bun/bin/bacpack && mkdir -p $(brew --prefix)/share/man/man1 && cp man/bacpack.1 $(brew --prefix)/share/man/man1/ && ([ -d ~/.claude/skills ] && cp -R bacpack-cli ~/.claude/skills/ || true)
